newsitem.title: USA: Aladdin takes 15 pct stake Wave.
newsitem.headline: Aladdin takes 15 pct stake Wave.

text.p: Wave Systems Corp said Monday Aladdin Knowledge Systems Ltd bought 500,000 shares and warrants to take a stake of up to 15 percent in Wave.
The deal is part of a licensing agreement whereby Aladdin licenses software execution control technology to Wave, the company said.
A Wave spokesman was not immediately available to elaborate on the deal.
Wave's stock traded at 1-31/32 Monday morning, up 5/32. Aladdin's shares were unchanged at 11-3/4.

Wave said Aladdin's technology will enable it to enhance the security of its information distribution and metering system. Wave added it agreed to pay Aladdin an initial license fee and future royalties.
